Lindverne's and Eldreda's invulnerable dodges. Basic Attack during the dodge gives a dash attack (Void Slash Rush / Reality Reversal).
Hold Dodge with a direction to enter Nightglide; Basic Attack then triggers Shadow Realm Raid, a Tail Swipe.
Smoldering Fire Reignition / Cold Flame Returning Edge
Lindverne's and Eldreda's Dodge Counters after a Perfect Dodge. Invulnerable.

Follow-ups by Dracaene (applies 1 Gash on the heavy hit), Lindverne and Eldreda.
Switches to Lindverne or Eldreda for Genesis Flare DMG.

core.name: Dream Manifestation = Genesis Reconstruction
core.text:
Her skills deal Sharp DMG, which scales with DEF, and build Gash (up to 3 stacks). Sharp CRITs use a Laceration DMG Bonus instead of CRIT DMG; CRIT Rate above 100% gives an extra Laceration check, and each 1% initial CRIT DMG adds 0.35% initial CRIT Rate.
Entering the field restores 60 Sharpness. Entering combat gives Midnight Sun for 20s (paused while others are on field): CRIT Rate +40% and 20% enemy DEF ignored; EX Special Attacks and Converging Edge refresh it.
Dracaene's Defensive Assist deals 50% more Daze and parries build Gash; Eldreda's and Lindverne's Assist Follow-Ups get +15% Gash buildup and +20% DMG.
Each Gash removed by a squad member's Maim gives 40 Wishfire (max 160); at 120 she can spend it on Converging Edge, and a teammate's Maim can bring her in for it as a Quick Assist (once every 3s).
Converging Edge, some EX Special Attacks and her Ultimates mark 60% of their DMG as Ember Scar (any squad Maim adds 35% of its DMG). Ultimate: By This Wish, All Things Remade turns all Ember Scar into Ashfall, direct HP loss, and enemies whose Ember Scar covers their remaining HP are executed. An enemy's death gives 40 Wishfire (once every 60s).

ability.name: Mark of a Leader
ability.text: With a Stun, Defense or another Armorer squadmate: her EX Special Attacks and Dash Attack: Patrol – Shadow Realm Raid put all Armorer Agents in United Will: Laceration DMG +25% for 45s.

mindscapes: On entering battle she gains 120 Wishfire (once every 180s in Investigation Zones). Gash Buildup Rate +10%, and her skills ignore 15% of the enemy's Fire RES.
Max Wishfire 200, and Ember Scar builds 25% faster. Her other skills also mark 18% of their DMG as Ember Scar. Converging Edge recovers 150 more Decibels.
Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack and Chain Attack Lv. +2.
Her DMG +15%. After Dracaene's Assist Follow-Up: Lighthouse, press Basic or Special Attack to follow up with Night Blaze – End of the Long Dark without spending Chain Teeth.
Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack and Chain Attack Lv. +2.

When By This Wish, All Things Remade triggers Ashfall, the target gets Ember Scar equal to all the Ember Scar that Ultimate built, and she follows up with Kindled Lamp – Torch of Eternal Day without spending Flag Order. Her skills ignore 15% of the target's DEF.
